description: This file is a FastAPI router module for managing media content such as text, video, and audio. It provides endpoints for listing, uploading, retrieving, updating, and deleting content, integrating with a SQL database and handling file storage, validation, and user authentication.

classes.description: ORM model representing the stored content item.
